target: Automated MEP construction estimation workflow with price validation

reference.location: Requirements from IT expert - DDC CWICR database, OpenTakeoff MCP, OpenConstructionERP

open_questions: What are the exact Qdrant collection dimensions for DDC CWICR?
What is the OpenTakeoff MCP API specification?
What Python orchestration framework to use (LangGraph, CrewAI, custom)?

checkpoints.title: Environment setup and dependency installation
done_when: Python virtual environment created with Qdrant and OpenTakeoff MCP installed
DDC CWICR Qdrant snapshot loaded with 55K+ work items
tests: qdrant collection count matches DDC CWICR spec (55K+ work items)
OpenTakeoff MCP server responds to ping

checkpoints.title: Takeoff integration - PDF/BIM quantity extraction
done_when: OpenTakeoff MCP extracts quantities (length, area, volume, count)
Output in standardized format for downstream processing
tests: Sample PDF with known quantities produces correct measurements

checkpoints.title: Cost database vector search interface
done_when: Qdrant collection indexed with DDC CWICR data with vector search
Search interface provides work item IDs and resource mappings
tests: Search for common MEP item returns expected results
Results include required fields (work_id, resource_id, unit_cost)

checkpoints.title: LLM orchestration layer
done_when: Agent coordinates takeoff → database search → cost calculation flow
Error handling for missing database entries with confidence scoring
tests: Full pipeline produces estimate for sample input

checkpoints.title: Price validation and sanity checking
done_when: ±20% benchmark validation implemented with productivity checks
tests: Estimate 20% below benchmark flagged as invalid

checkpoints.title: Output generation - BOQ and reports
done_when: Verified BOQ generated in standard format with confidence ranges
Cost report with line-item breakdown produced
tests: BOQ contains all required fields and totals

checkpoints.title: Integration testing with real drawings
done_when: End-to-end test with sample construction drawing validates accuracy
tests: Full pipeline runs without errors on test drawing
Estimated costs within acceptable margin of known values
